Good Value for Money BBQ!
Sep 2023
First, a disclaimer. I will upload the pics once this review is approved as TA does not allow the first reviewer to upload pictures and not sure why.

We were shopping in the mall and came by at around 3.10pm as they had the afternoon happy hour promotion (between 3-5pm) with a 30% discount off the usual buffet price.

The restaurant was spacious and cosy though not all the seats were with back support and felt like dinning in a canteen but that was alright with the ambience and cooling aircon.

When we arrived, the restaurant was about 50% full in capacity though it was already past 3pm, probably due to the promotion. We were ushered by the staff to the table and soon we started.

There were food on the booth tables, such as veggies and marinated meats like beef, pork, chicken, instant noodles, rice etc. In addition, upon ordering through the staff, they would serve "premium meats and seafood" (because we opted for the higher price buffet) to our table. Generally, the meats were well marinated and nice.

Staff regularly came by automatically (without request) to change the BBQ metal plate which was good. But the ordering of the premium meats was not well communicated to us, they just left a piece of paper on our table without explaining to us (or possibly due to language barrier) until almost half way through we then realized we could order other foods not on display after looking around our next door tables. Maybe they could also have the English translation on the paper.

There were also pickles and fresh cut fruits, besides softdrinks and ice creams.

Overall, it was a good value for money and highly satisfactory meal and we enjoyed very much.
